text:
kat: Quick pattern-check thread — pulled closed postmortems for Feb/Mar and found several items with overdue remediation owners listed as 'unassigned' or stale. Putting a proposed cleanup cadence here.

omar: Saw that too. A few follow-ups never got owners after the rerun of the rollout.

sylvie: Which tracker rows are we talking about? I can take ownership if they're infra-related.

dan: I flagged 6 PMR rows in the tracker (ids 121..126) where the ETA passed and no progress note. Two are labeled 'storage-eviction' and three 'fallbacks'.

kat: Proposed cadence: weekly sweep for any action where owner is missing OR last_update > 30 days and status != done. Move to "stale" and assign on-call to re-triage. Owner: kat to prototype automation. ETA: 2026-04-02.

omar: Agree. For automation, we should add a slack notify to the original incident channel and ping the oncall rotation.

sylvie: I can add a rubric for auto-assign defaults (eg: infra -> infra-owner, runtime->eng-runtime lead).

ops-bot: Note from automation logs: last sweep 2026-02-10 found 18 stale items; 12 were re-assigned manually.

dan: Small blocker: some remediations are gated on cross-team design reviews. We should mark those with tag 'blocked:design' so sweeps skip them.

kat: Good point. Sweep rules will skip items with 'blocked' tag. Also adding a quick SQL used to find candidates: ```sql
SELECT id, summary, owner, status, last_update
FROM pmr_actions
WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND status != 'done'
AND (owner IS NULL OR last_update < now() - interval '30 days');
```

omar: For transparency, let's add a column 'sweep_owner' that points to who performed the last sweep and a sweep_ts. Helps audit.

sylvie: I'll update the tracker schema and send a short PR.

dan: Can we add a small SLA: owner assignment within 7 days of sweep or escalate to manager?

kat: Proposed SLA accepted. Owner assignment within 7 days, otherwise auto-escalate a daily digest to managers. I'll draft escalation text.

omar: Also recommend a monthly "pattern digest" summarizing top 5 recurring root causes and remediation completion rate. Tracker should export these automatically.

sylvie: I'll wire a simple script to compute completion rate per root_cause. ETA: 2026-04-08.

ops-bot: Reminder created: weekly-sweep job starting 2026-04-03 08:00 PT.

kat: Can folks react with :thumbsup: to accept responsibilities: kat (automation prototype + sweep policy), sylvie (tracker schema + script), omar (sweep slack notifier), dan (scan & initial gating tags).

sylvie: +1 :thumbsup:

omar: +1

dan: +1

kat: Thanks. I'll post a short RFC for the sweep automation and add a sample alert payload. We'll re-check progress at the monthly recurring-patterns review.

ops-bot: Thread archived to incident-patterns index.
